title: Adding Suffixes Correctly in a Text

instruction.text: Read the following sentence about food and select the word that needs a suffix to make sense.

atoms.b: Most people have a favourite food based on the food’s ((tasty)).
atoms.sound: Most people have a favourite food based on the food’s ((tasty)).

instruction.text: Which word should you use instead of 'tasty'?

atoms.b: Most people have a favourite food based on the food’s ((++tastiness tasting)).

instruction.text: Read the following sentence about food and select the word that needs a suffix to make sense.

atoms.b: Some people don’t like mushrooms because of their ((chewy)), but mushrooms are my favourite food.
atoms.sound: Some people don’t like mushrooms because of their ((chewy)), but mushrooms are my favourite food.

instruction.text: Which word should you use instead of 'chewy'?

atoms.b: Some people don’t like mushrooms because of their ((++chewiness chewed)), but mushrooms are my favourite food.

instruction.text: Read the following sentence about food and select the word that needs a suffix to make sense.

atoms.b: I have made a lot of ((improve)) in my cooking, because I cook with mushrooms a lot.
atoms.sound: I have made a lot of ((improve)) in my cooking, because I cook with mushrooms a lot.

instruction.text: Which word should you use instead of 'improve'?

atoms.b: I have made a lot of ((++improvement improves)) in my cooking, because I cook with mushrooms a lot.

instruction.text: Read the following sentence about food and select the word that needs a suffix to make sense.

atoms.b: It’s important to have lots of ((vary)) in your diet.
atoms.sound: It’s important to have lots of ((vary)) in your diet.

instruction.text: Which word should you use instead of 'vary'?

atoms.b: It’s important to have lots of ((++variation varyness)) in your diet.

instruction.text: Read the following sentence about food and select the word that needs a suffix to make sense.

atoms.b: If you don’t eat a mixture of lots of different foods, you won’t get enough ((nourish)).
atoms.sound: If you don’t eat a mixture of lots of different foods, you won’t get enough ((nourish)).

instruction.text: Which word should you use instead of 'nourish'?

atoms.b: If you don’t eat a mixture of lots of different foods, you won’t get enough ((++nourishment nourishing)).

instruction.text: Read the following sentence about food and select the word that needs a suffix to make sense.

atoms.b: These days you get a good ((educate)) in schools about food and nutrition, so you can make healthy choices.
atoms.sound: These days you get a good ((educate)) in schools about food and nutrition, so you can make healthy choices.

instruction.text: Which word should you use instead of 'educate'?

atoms.b: These days you get a good ((++education educatement)) in schools about food and nutrition, so you can make healthy choices.
